plain_italian_summary: Questo gate chiarisce cosa il proprietario deve approvare prima che README, docs, OpenAPI/Postman, MCP descriptor o pagine pubbliche possano essere considerati pubblicabili. Anche se lo scan wording e' pulito, non c'e' ancora approvazione per vendita, pubblicazione marketplace, pagamenti, dati reali o go-live.

owner_must_confirm: Text is understandable and aligned with business positioning.
No statement sounds like paid/live offer.
No legal/privacy approval is implied.
Machine-first positioning is acceptable.
approval_categories.approval_effect_if_confirmed_later: Docs can be treated as owner-approved draft-public wording, not commercial go-live.

owner_must_confirm: Endpoints are acceptable as sandbox/pre-live contract.

Machine-readable no-go wording is acceptable.
approval_categories.approval_effect_if_confirmed_later: Contracts can be used for sandbox evaluation, not paid live access.

Hosted MCP remains blocked.

No external listing or submission occurs without explicit approval.
approval_categories.approval_effect_if_confirmed_later: Machine discovery remains sandbox/private; public registry still requires separate approval.
